---
title: "Tu+12 at Rutgers"
---
___
We are pleased to announce that the **12th iteration of the Workshop on Turkic and Languages in Contact with Turkic** (TU+12) will be hosted by the Department of Linguistics at Rutgers University. The workshop will be held at Rutgers University in New Brunswick, NJ, on April 17-18, 2027 in-person. The abstract submissions are now open.<br><br>
TU+ is an annual workshop focusing on all aspects of linguistic research on **Turkic languages**, as well as on **languages in contact with Turkic and on languages spoken in regions where Turkic languages are spoken**. TU+ showcases theoretically informed and data-driven work across phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, psycholinguistics, neurolinguistics, historical linguistics, and computational approaches. **This year we would like to especially encourage phonologically- and phonetically-oriented contributions**.<br>
